source_window.dataset: OS OpenMap - Local Product Guide and Technical Specification - ImportantBuilding

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public OS OpenMap Local ImportantBuilding feature for Exeter with the feature's generalised building polygon and record-bound buildingTheme/classification/distinctiveName values. The selected Ordnance Survey technical-specification window confirms that ImportantBuilding carries a GM_Surface polygon plus explicit theme, function classification and site name in the same feature, but the source window is schema-level documentation and exposes no individual Exeter ImportantBuilding feature or polygon coordinates; therefore source-area/schema metadata was inspected without parcel-progress credit and no individual building record was accepted.
